The national portal federated the Municipalidad Distrital de Miraflores catalogue once, on 13 November 2018, and never again: every one of these entries carries 'Harvested from Cosechamiento de Datos Municipalidad de Miraflores', Last Harvest Performed 13/11/2018, a template 'Triennial' frequency, sequential machine-minted identifiers, a Homepage URL pointing at datosabiertos.miraflores.gob.pe and a single stub resource of format html with no file behind it. The geo-fence hypothesis was tested and rejected: datosabiertos.gob.pe resolves and serves normally from a Peru exit, while datosabiertos.miraflores.gob.pe fails to RESOLVE AT ALL (DNS, not 403) - the host is gone, not restricted. 77 such entries exist portal-wide and all 77 are Miraflores'. Data that cannot be obtained cannot be counted as available. Verified by opening the pages, 2026-08-25; evidence in miraflores_ghosts_2026-08-25.csv.

The national portal federated the Municipalidad Distrital de Miraflores catalogue once, on 13 November 2018, and never again: every one of these entries carries 'Harvested from Cosechamiento de Datos Municipalidad de Miraflores', Last Harvest Performed 13/11/2018, a template 'Triennial' frequency, sequential machine-minted identifiers, a Homepage URL pointing at datosabiertos.miraflores.gob.pe and a single stub resource of format html with no file behind it. Data that cannot be obtained cannot be counted as available. Verified by opening the pages, 2026-08-25; evidence in miraflores_ghosts_2026-08-25.csv.

title: Infracciones de Cinemómetros - [Municipalidad Metropolitana de Lima] MML
description_en: Infracciones de Cinemometros - [Municipalidad Metropolitana de Lima] MML: speed-camera violations recorded by the metropolitan municipality under DS 016-2009-MTC. One row per detected infraction with the posted limit (VELOCIDAD_MAXIMA), the detected speed, the street address and the district. - Source: https://www.datosabiertos.gob.pe/dataset/infracciones-de-cinemometros-municipalidad-metropolitana-de-lima-mml
round_tag: ADDED 2026-08-26: recovered by the Lima/Callao publisher-group enumeration that the original keyword scrape never ran (munlima_national_harvest.py had been left at PROBE_ONLY). 3 keeps + cinemometros + Lima Reporta out of 39 PA-keyword candidates; the other 34 exit, 9 of them as 2018 harvest stubs. Dispositions and evidence in 04_metadata_outputs/lima_munlima_candidates.xlsx - 195,620 rows 5 Jun 2024 - 9 Mar 2026; 21 districts, 191 enforcement locations, but only 14 cameras, and Magdalena del Mar alone is 42% of all violations. 64% of records carry a 30 km/h posted limit. Measures where the cameras are, not speed management across Lima - hence proxy.

title: Infracciones de Lima Reporta - [Municipalidad Metropolitana de Lima] MML
description_en: Infracciones de Lima Reporta - [Municipalidad Metropolitana de Lima] MML: traffic and parking violations logged by municipal inspectors through the Lima Reporta mobile app, one row per detected infraction with street address, district, infraction code and evidence status. - Source: https://www.datosabiertos.gob.pe/dataset/infracciones-de-lima-reporta-municipalidad-metropolitana-de-lima-mml
round_tag: ADDED 2026-08-26: recovered by the Lima/Callao publisher-group enumeration that the original keyword scrape never ran (munlima_national_harvest.py had been left at PROBE_ONLY). 3 keeps + cinemometros + Lima Reporta out of 39 PA-keyword candidates; the other 34 exit, 9 of them as 2018 harvest stubs. Dispositions and evidence in 04_metadata_outputs/lima_munlima_candidates.xlsx - 257,064 rows 19 Jun 2024 - 31 Mar 2026; 38 districts, 44,229 distinct addresses. Dominated by parking codes: G40 zonas prohibidas 92,113, G11 islas de refugio y encauzamiento 40,920, G47 obstruccion del transporte publico 32,229, G41 crucero peatonal 1,847, M44 obstruir la ciclovia 307. 43,850 rows (17.1%) name pedestrian or cycle space explicitly, and 86,424 (33.6%) are NS* non-sanctions. NO indicator link, ruled 2026-08-26: the record is EVENTS, not zones - every row carries FECHA_INFRACCION, HORA_INFRACCION and ESTADO_EVIDENCIA, and there is no zone designation or geometry anywhere in it. A register of prohibited ZONES would have supported a pedestrian-infrastructure link; a register of infractions does not.

title: MDSI - Seguridad Ciudadana, Tránsito y Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres [San Isidro]
description_en: MDSI - Seguridad Ciudadana, Transito y Gestion del Riesgo de Desastres [Municipalidad Distrital de San Isidro]: municipal warden dispatch log with latitude and longitude, including a road-collision series carrying the cause of each crash. - Source: https://www.datosabiertos.gob.pe/dataset/mdsi-seguridad-ciudadana-transito-y-gestion-del-riesgo-de-desastres
proxy_link: Road traffic injury and fatality rates
round_tag: ADDED 2026-08-26: recovered by the Lima/Callao publisher-group enumeration that the original keyword scrape never ran (munlima_national_harvest.py had been left at PROBE_ONLY). 3 keeps + cinemometros + Lima Reporta out of 39 PA-keyword candidates; the other 34 exit, 9 of them as 2018 harvest stubs. Dispositions and evidence in 04_metadata_outputs/lima_munlima_candidates.xlsx - 39,224 rows with LAT/LON over 12,620 addresses, but CATEGORIA is APOYO POR SEGURIDAD throughout: it is a serenazgo dispatch log, not crime incidence. The link rests on a 919-row TIPO=ACCIDENTES slice - geocoded crashes with MODALIDAD giving the cause (imprudencia del conductor 512, exceso de velocidad 315, imprudencia del peaton 6, pista en mal estado 4). Comparable in GEOMETRY to EXT:ANT_FSA_10 (Statbel), EXT:ROT_FSA_12 and EXT:LJU_FSA_23; Lima and Kampala are otherwise the only cities with no point-level crash data. NOT comparable in severity - no casualty counts - so proxy, not Direct. Covers one district of ~60,000 people.
